name: Is spray foam insulation better than traditional batt or blown-in insulation for walls?

mainEntity.name: Is spray foam insulation better than traditional batt or blown-in insulation for walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spray foam insulation often provides a superior air seal and higher R-value per inch compared to traditional batt or blown-in options. Its ability to expand and fill irregular spaces eliminates air gaps, preventing heat loss more effectively. However, it is generally more expensive to install and requires professional application due to its chemical nature. While batt and blown-in options are cost-effective and perform well when installed correctly, spray foam typically offers enhanced energy performance and moisture resistance, making it a premium choice for specific needs.
